messages:
Nia (PM): 2hr check before GA: concise list - SLA wording, rollback steps, monitoring suppressions, pricing SKUs + promo opt-in, support templates. Quick owners?
Cal (Eng): I'll paste a tiny rollback bullet list and a curl+SDK snippet. Also confirm fallback behavior choice.
Jo (SRE): I'll handle monitoring/severity map and run a smoke at +10m post-deploy. Plan: 0-10m=info, 10-60m=warn, >60m=page.
Kim (Legal): I'll redline SLA reparations; prefer explicit transient exclusion (<5m) and opt-in for soft-fallback.
Lee (Finance): Pricing SKUs: hosted.generate.standard and hosted.generate.burst. Promo = PROMO-GA-OPTIN (3mo 10%), opt-in only. Need billing flag name.
Cal (Eng): Rollback (short): 1) switch to fallback route, 2) drain pool, 3) spin reserve node, 4) invalidate KV cache, 5) smoke test + promote. Snippet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-v1","input":"Hi"}'`
DocsBot: I'll merge quickstart once legal redlines and billing flag are in.
Nia (PM): Owners recap: SLA=Kim, Rollback+snippets=Cal, Monitoring=Jo, Pricing=Lee, Docs=DocsBot. Target: close in 2h for deploy. Post blockers here. :white_check_mark:
